purpose: Compare places; teach 欧米/香港/アフリカ/わが国/神戸/広島/直前/殆ど

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 欧米と香港、どっちが楽しい？
lines.en: Europe/America or Hong Kong — which is more fun?
lines.style: friend posing a fun question, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: それぞれ違う良さがあるよ。
lines.style: friend answering wisely, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: アフリカは未知の世界って感じだよね。
lines.en: Africa feels like an unknown world.
lines.style: curious friend imagining, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: わが国にも、神戸や広島みたいに国際的な街がある。
lines.en: In our country too, there are international cities like Kobe and Hiroshima.
lines.style: friend grounding it locally, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 旅って、直前のワクワクが好き。
lines.style: friend savoring the feeling, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: でも準備殆どできてないと、焦るよ。
lines.en: But if you’ve barely prepped, you panic.
lines.style: friend laughing wryly, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: それも旅の醍醐味だね。
lines.en: That’s part of the joy of travel too.
lines.style: friend embracing the chaos, tone holding steady through the whole line
